tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, m.subject_id, m.total_marks FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.total_marks = (SELECT MAX(total_marks) FROM marks WHERE subject_id = m.subject_id);

src_nl: Show students enrolled in courses across multiple semesters
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.semester) > 1;

src_nl: Find students with total internal marks greater than total external marks
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(m.internal_marks) AS total_internal, SUM(m.external_marks) AS total_external FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING SUM(m.internal_marks) > SUM(m.external_marks);

src_nl: Get students who are not enrolled in the current semester
tgt_sql: SELECT s.* FROM student s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollment e WHERE s.student_id = e.student_id AND e.semester = EXTRACT(SEMESTER FROM CURRENT_DATE));

src_nl: List students along with courses taught by faculty with salary above 100000
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name, c.course_name FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id JOIN faculty f ON c.department_id = f.department_id WHERE f.salary > 100000;

src_nl: Show students who belong to departments established after 2015
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM student s JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.established_date > '2015-01-01';

src_nl: Find students whose HOD name contains 'Kumar'
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM student s JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.hod_name LIKE '%Kumar%';

src_nl: Get students along with the number of subjects with grade 'A'
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(m.subject_id) AS grade_a_subjects FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.grade = 'A' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: List students who have attended all classes in semester 2 subjects
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id JOIN subject sub ON a.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE sub.semester = 2 AND a.attended_classes = a.total_classes;

src_nl: Show students with emails not in 'gmail.com' domain
tgt_sql: SELECT * FROM student WHERE email NOT LIKE '%gmail.com';

src_nl: Find students who are enrolled in courses worth more than 10 credits in total
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(c.credits) AS total_credits FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING SUM(c.credits) > 10;

src_nl: Get students along with average marks in each subject
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, sub.subject_name, AVG(m.total_marks) AS avg_marks FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id JOIN subject sub ON m.subject_id = sub.subject_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, sub.subject_name;

src_nl: List students along with their faculty names teaching any of their subjects
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name, f.first_name AS faculty_first, f.last_name AS faculty_last FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id JOIN subject sub ON m.subject_id = sub.subject_id JOIN faculty f ON sub.faculty_id = f.faculty_id;

src_nl: Show students who have internal marks between 30 and 60
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.internal_marks BETWEEN 30 AND 60;

src_nl: Find students with average total marks below 50
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, AVG(m.total_marks) AS avg_total FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING AVG(m.total_marks) < 50;

src_nl: Get students along with the list of subjects they scored grade 'B' in
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, STRING_AGG(sub.subject_name, ', ') AS subjects_with_B FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id JOIN subject sub ON m.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE m.grade = 'B' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: List students who have never scored above 90 in any subject
tgt_sql: SELECT s.* FROM student s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marks m WHERE s.student_id = m.student_id AND m.total_marks > 90);

src_nl: Show students with total attendance percentage above 95%
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, AVG(a.attendance_percentage) AS avg_attendance FROM student s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING AVG(a.attendance_percentage) > 95;

src_nl: Find students who have enrolled in more than 5 courses
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(e.course_id) AS course_count FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(e.course_id) > 5;

src_nl: Get students along with total marks for semester 1
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(m.total_marks) AS total_marks_sem1 FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.semester = 1 GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: List students who belong to departments with more than 10 faculty members
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM student s JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id JOIN faculty f ON d.department_id = f.department_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, d.department_id HAVING COUNT(f.faculty_id) > 10;

src_nl: Show students who have attended less than 50% of classes in any subject of semester 2
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id JOIN subject sub ON a.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE sub.semester = 2 AND a.attendance_percentage < 50;

src_nl: Find students who scored grade 'A' in all subjects of semester 1
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id JOIN subject sub ON m.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE sub.semester = 1 GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN m.grade = 'A' THEN 1 END) = COUNT(sub.subject_id);

src_nl: Get students along with the earliest enrollment date in any course
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, MIN(e.enroll_date) AS first_enroll FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: List students who have both internal marks above 50 and external marks above 50 in any subject
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.internal_marks > 50 AND m.external_marks > 50;

src_nl: Show students enrolled in courses from at least 2 different departments
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.department_id) >= 2;

src_nl: Find students with the lowest total marks in any subject
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, m.subject_id, m.total_marks FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.total_marks = (SELECT MIN(total_marks) FROM marks WHERE subject_id = m.subject_id);

src_nl: Get students who have a phone number starting with '999' and email ending with 'edu'
tgt_sql: SELECT * FROM student WHERE phone LIKE '999%' AND email LIKE '%.edu';

src_nl: List students along with the count of subjects they have failed (marks < 40)
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(m.subject_id) AS failed_subjects FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.total_marks < 40 GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: Show students who have attended all classes in semester 3 subjects
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id JOIN subject sub ON a.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE sub.semester = 3 AND a.attended_classes = a.total_classes;

src_nl: Find students who belong to departments where the HOD name starts with 'Dr.'
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM student s JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.hod_name LIKE 'Dr.%';

src_nl: Get students along with the number of courses they are enrolled in per semester
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, e.semester, COUNT(e.course_id) AS courses_per_semester FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, e.semester;

src_nl: List students who have never enrolled in semester 1 courses
tgt_sql: SELECT * FROM student s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollment e WHERE s.student_id = e.student_id AND e.semester = 1);

src_nl: Show students along with the total number of active enrollments
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS active_enrollments FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: Find students with internal marks greater than external marks in at least one subject
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.internal_marks > m.external_marks;

src_nl: Get students and the number of subjects they attended more than 90% of classes
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(a.subject_id) AS subjects_attended_90_plus FROM student s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id WHERE a.attendance_percentage > 90 GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: List students who belong to departments with less than 5 courses
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id JOIN course c ON d.department_id = c.department_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, d.department_id HAVING COUNT(c.course_id) < 5;

src_nl: Show students who scored grade 'D' in more than 2 subjects
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(m.subject_id) AS grade_d_count FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.grade = 'D' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(m.subject_id) > 2;

src_nl: Find students with department established before 2000
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM student s JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.established_date < '2000-01-01';

src_nl: Get students who are enrolled in courses taught by faculty with designation 'Professor'
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id JOIN faculty f ON c.department_id = f.department_id WHERE f.designation = 'Professor';

src_nl: List students who have attended fewer classes than the average attendance for their department
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM student s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, d.department_id HAVING AVG(a.attendance_percentage) < (SELECT AVG(a2.attendance_percentage) FROM student s2 JOIN attendance a2 ON s2.student_id = a2.student_id WHERE s2.department_id = d.department_id);

src_nl: Show students who scored maximum total marks in their department
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, m.total_marks FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.total_marks = (SELECT MAX(m2.total_marks) FROM student s2 JOIN marks m2 ON s2.student_id = m2.student_id WHERE s2.department_id = s.department_id);

src_nl: Find students enrolled in courses with duration more than 3 years
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.duration_years > 3;

src_nl: Get students who have multiple email addresses ending with the same domain
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, s.email FROM student s GROUP BY s.first_name, s.last_name, s.email HAVING COUNT(s.email) > 1;

src_nl: List students along with the total marks they obtained in semester 2
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(m.total_marks) AS total_sem2_marks FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.semester = 2 GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: Show students who have enrolled in both online and offline courses
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.description LIKE '%online%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollment e2 JOIN course c2 ON e2.course_id = c2.course_id WHERE e2.student_id = s.student_id AND c2.description LIKE '%offline%');

src_nl: Find students whose total attendance percentage across all subjects is below 60%
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(a.attended_classes)/SUM(a.total_classes)*100 AS overall_attendance FROM student s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING SUM(a.attended_classes)/SUM(a.total_classes)*100 < 60;

src_nl: Get students who have scored grade 'A' in more than 50% of their subjects
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(m.subject_id)::decimal/ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marks m2 WHERE m2.student_id = s.student_id) AS grade_a_ratio FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.grade = 'A' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(m.subject_id)::decimal / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marks m2 WHERE m2.student_id = s.student_id) > 0.5;

src_nl: List students along with the earliest date they joined any course
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, MIN(e.enroll_date) AS first_course_date FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: Show students who have attended all classes of subjects taught by faculty with salary above 120000
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id JOIN subject sub ON a.subject_id = sub.subject_id JOIN faculty f ON sub.faculty_id = f.faculty_id WHERE a.attended_classes = a.total_classes AND f.salary > 120000;

src_nl: Find students with total marks in all subjects greater than 500
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(m.total_marks) AS total_marks FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING SUM(m.total_marks) > 500;

src_nl: Get students who have enrollment records in the current academic year but no marks recorded yet
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.academic_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marks m WHERE m.student_id = s.student_id);

src_nl: List students along with the total number of courses in their department
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(c.course_id) AS total_department_courses FROM student s JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id JOIN course c ON d.department_id = c.department_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: Show students who have scored below 40 in internal marks for any subject
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.internal_marks < 40;

src_nl: Find students whose total attendance percentage is higher than 90%
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(a.attended_classes)/SUM(a.total_classes)*100 AS total_attendance FROM student s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING SUM(a.attended_classes)/SUM(a.total_classes)*100 > 90;

src_nl: Get students who have enrolled in courses from the 'Engineering' department
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id JOIN department d ON c.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Engineering';

src_nl: List students along with the total marks obtained in 'Mathematics'
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(m.total_marks) AS total_math_marks FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id JOIN subject sub ON m.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE sub.subject_name = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: Show students who have not attended any classes in semester 1
tgt_sql: SELECT * FROM student s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attendance a JOIN subject sub ON a.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE s.student_id = a.student_id AND sub.semester = 1);

src_nl: Find students with more than 3 subjects in semester 2
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(sub.subject_id) AS subject_count FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id JOIN subject sub ON m.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE sub.semester = 2 GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(sub.subject_id) > 3;

src_nl: Get students along with the HOD name of their department
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, d.hod_name FROM student s JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id;

src_nl: List students who have enrollment records in the last 6 months
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.enroll_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months';

src_nl: Show students with external marks greater than 70 in all subjects
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING MIN(m.external_marks) > 70;

src_nl: Find students who have enrolled in both 'Physics' and 'Chemistry' courses
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN enrollment e1 ON s.student_id = e1.student_id JOIN course c1 ON e1.course_id = c1.course_id JOIN enrollment e2 ON s.student_id = e2.student_id JOIN course c2 ON e2.course_id = c2.course_id WHERE c1.course_name = 'Physics' AND c2.course_name = 'Chemistry';

src_nl: Get students who have total marks above 400 in semester 1
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(m.total_marks) AS semester1_total FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.semester = 1 GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING SUM(m.total_marks) > 400;

src_nl: List students whose department has more than 50 students
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id JOIN student s2 ON d.department_id = s2.department_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, d.department_id HAVING COUNT(s2.student_id) > 50;

src_nl: Show students who have scored grade 'B' in at least 2 subjects
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(m.subject_id) AS grade_b_count FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.grade = 'B' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(m.subject_id) >= 2;

src_nl: Find students who are enrolled in courses with credits less than 3
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.credits < 3;

src_nl: Get students who have both internal and external marks below 50 in any subject
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.internal_marks < 50 AND m.external_marks < 50;

src_nl: List students along with the faculty teaching their semester 1 subjects
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name, f.first_name AS faculty_first, f.last_name AS faculty_last FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id JOIN subject sub ON m.subject_id = sub.subject_id JOIN faculty f ON sub.faculty_id = f.faculty_id WHERE sub.semester = 1;

src_nl: Show students who have attended at least 90% of classes in all subjects
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM student s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING MIN(a.attendance_percentage) >= 90;

src_nl: Find students who have enrollment in current semester but no marks recorded yet
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.semester = EXTRACT(SEMESTER FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marks m WHERE m.student_id = s.student_id);

src_nl: Get students who have scored highest marks in semester 2 subjects
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, m.subject_id, m.total_marks FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.semester = 2 AND m.total_marks = (SELECT MAX(total_marks) FROM marks WHERE semester = 2 AND subject_id = m.subject_id);

src_nl: List students along with their total number of marks entries
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(m.marks_id) AS total_marks_entries FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: Show students who have scored exactly 100 in any subject
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.total_marks = 100;

src_nl: Find students whose first name starts with 'A'
tgt_sql: SELECT * FROM student WHERE first_name LIKE 'A%';

src_nl: Get students who are enrolled in more than one course in the current academic year
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(e.course_id) AS courses_count FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.academic_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(e.course_id) > 1;

src_nl: List students along with the number of subjects taught by faculty with 'PhD' qualification
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(sub.subject_id) AS phd_subjects FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id JOIN subject sub ON m.subject_id = sub.subject_id JOIN faculty f ON sub.faculty_id = f.faculty_id WHERE f.qualification LIKE '%PhD%' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name;

src_nl: Show students who have attended classes in more than 3 subjects in semester 1
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.subject_id) AS subjects_count FROM student s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id JOIN subject sub ON a.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE sub.semester = 1 GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.subject_id) > 3;

src_nl: Find students who have never scored grade 'E'
tgt_sql: SELECT s.* FROM student s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marks m WHERE s.student_id = m.student_id AND m.grade = 'E');

src_nl: Get students along with their department and the number of students in the same department
tgt_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, d.department_name, COUNT(s2.student_id) AS department_student_count FROM student s JOIN department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id JOIN student s2 ON d.department_id = s2.department_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, d.department_name;

src_nl: List students who have enrolled in courses with duration equal to 2 years
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.duration_years = 2;

src_nl: Show students with phone numbers ending with '7890'
tgt_sql: SELECT * FROM student WHERE phone LIKE '%7890';

src_nl: Find students who have scored grade 'C' in at least one subject in semester 2
tgt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id JOIN subject sub ON m.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE sub.semester = 2 AND m.grade = 'C';

src_nl: Get students who have attended more than 80% in semester 3 subjects

src_nl: List all students with grades between 'B' and 'D' in semester 4
tgt_sql: SELECT student_id, grade FROM marks WHERE semester = 4 AND grade IN ('B', 'C', 'D');

src_nl: Show students with total marks greater than 80 in subject 101
tgt_sql: SELECT student_id FROM marks WHERE subject_id = 101 AND total_marks > 80;

src_nl: Find average total marks scored by male and female students separately
tgt_sql: SELECT s.gender, AVG(m.total_marks) AS avg_total FROM marks m JOIN student s ON m.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.gender;

src_nl: Get students who have scored exactly 50 in external marks
tgt_sql: SELECT student_id FROM marks WHERE external_marks = 50;

src_nl: List subjects with the most exams conducted in semester 1
tgt_sql: SELECT subject_id, COUNT(*) AS exam_count FROM marks WHERE semester = 1 GROUP BY subject_id ORDER BY exam_count DESC LIMIT 3;

src_nl: Show the total number of distinct students who appeared for exams per semester
tgt_sql: SELECT semester, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS student_count FROM marks GROUP BY semester;
